template: multiply(ts_mean(zscore(winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), std=4)), 5), if_else(less(ts_delta(winsorize(ts_std_dev(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 60), std=4), 20), 0), 1.2, 0.8))
idea: 平滑背离与信息事件增强：采用5日均值平滑（ts_mean，较decay_linear更低换手）处理背离信号，并检测波动率是否近期下降作为信息事件标志。在事件窗口内放大信号强度，非事件窗口保守配置。
